chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
No one can establish the rule of Allah, the Glorified, except he who shows no relenting (in the matter of right), who does not behave like wrong doers and who does not run after objects of greed.
ai.seo_question: What are the three key qualities required to establish the rule of Allah according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines the essential character of the righteous ruler or judge, emphasizing that true establishment of God's authority (*iqamat amr Allah*) demands independence from political flattery (*muṣānaʿa*) and freedom from worldly ambition (*maṭābiʿ*). This reflects the Shia scholarly view that justice requires not only legal correctness but also moral fortitude to resist the corrupting influence of power and personal gain.
